parts.problem_md:
A scientist investigates soils.

Explain why the gas content of a soil is important for plant growth.
parts.solution_md:
The gases in soil include oxygen  **[1 mark]**. Plant roots need oxygen for aerobic respiration  **[1 mark]**, which releases the energy the roots use to grow and take up mineral ions  **[1 mark]**.

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **Mark allocation**
> 
> This answer is assessed using a point-marked approach.
> 
> - One mark for each valid point
> - Maximum 3 marks
> 
> **Common errors**
> 
> - Writing 'anaerobic respiration', which does not need oxygen

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Build a chain: oxygen, then respiration, then energy, then what the energy is used for. Each link can earn a mark.

parts.problem_md:
A scientist investigates soils.

Figure 3.1 shows the composition of a soil.

![Pie chart showing soil composition: mineral particles are grey, water is dotted, gases are unshaded, and X is a small diagonally hatched sector near the top. The key labels all four categories.](assets/001-pie-chart-showing-soil-composition-mineral-parti.png)

*Figure 3.1*

Calculate the percentage of the soil that is pore space.
parts.solution_md:
Pore space is filled with water and gases: 25 + 25 = **50%**  **[1 mark]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Pore space is the gaps between the particles, so add the water and the gases together.

Figure 1.1 shows data collected at a farm in Finland.

![Combined bar-and-line chart of Finland’s monthly precipitation and temperature. Precipitation bars (millimetres) are Jan 44, Feb 32, Mar 36, Apr 34, May 35, Jun 54, Jul 79, Aug 81, Sep 64, Oct 64, Nov 60, Dec 52.](assets/002-combined-bar-and-line-chart-of-finland-s-monthly.png)

*Figure 1.1*

Sorghum is a crop plant. Sorghum needs a growing season of four months.

Sorghum seeds need a minimum temperature of 12 °C to start to grow.

Sorghum plants need a minimum temperature of 15 °C to grow into a crop that can be harvested.

Suggest why sorghum is not a suitable crop to grow on the farm in Finland.

Use Figure 1.1 to support your answer.
parts.solution_md:
Only June, July and August reach 12 °C or more, so the seeds could only start to grow in these months  **[1 mark]**. Three warm months is shorter than the four-month growing season sorghum needs  **[1 mark]**.

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Use the figures you are given in the question (12 °C, 15 °C, four months) and check each one against the graph.

parts.problem_md:
Figure 1.1 shows data collected at a farm in Finland.

![Combined bar-and-line chart of Finland’s monthly precipitation and temperature. Precipitation bars (millimetres) are Jan 44, Feb 32, Mar 36, Apr 34, May 35, Jun 54, Jul 79, Aug 81, Sep 64, Oct 64, Nov 60, Dec 52.](assets/002-combined-bar-and-line-chart-of-finland-s-monthly.png)

*Figure 1.1*

Calculate the annual temperature range for this farm.
parts.solution_md:
Highest mean monthly temperature = 17 °C and lowest = -7 °C  **[1 mark]**

Range = 17 - (-7) = **24 °C**  **[1 mark]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding it, so the range is 17 + 7. A common wrong answer is 10 °C (17 - 7).
